name: CECODES DASHBOARD workbook, PRINCIPAL sample company
source: docs/sample-data/CEC-PR-F-024 - DASHBOARD (2025).xlsx, sheet PRINCIPAL, received 2026-07-24. Entries are the BASE_emisiones and BASE_energia table rows; expected totals are the Excel's OWN cached formula results, transcribed cell by cell (never recomputed by us). Factor values come from the same workbook's Emission Factors sheet, which the PRINCIPAL formulas VLOOKUP into.
notes: BASE_remociones (removals) is a SEPARATE table in the Excel with its own total (-256.40265 t) that is never added to the emissions total; its 13 rows are transcribed below under category Remociones and asserted via expectedRemovals, proving the rollup diverts them exactly as the Excel does. BASE_evitadas (tecnologias mas limpias) is reported without affecting any calculation (CECODES, 2026-07-24) and is not here. The sample mixes four sedes in one table; the rollup has no sede axis, and sums are linear, so the totals are unaffected. The urea row reproduces the Excel faithfully: its 0.7333 factor sits in the sheet's N2O column and is therefore multiplied by 273, which parity means matching, because parity is about what the spreadsheet EXECUTES; CECODES's official sheet has the same placement, and the 2026-09-03 factor correction moved our own library's urea factor into the N2O column to match it.

entries.note: Ball Cajica. The factor 0.7333333... = 0.2*(44/12) sits in the sheet's kg-N2O column (labeled 'kg CO2e/kg urea'), so the Excel computes 32626 x 0.73333 = 23925.7333 'kg N2O' x 273 = 6531725.2 kg CO2e. Reproduced faithfully.

Ball Sesquile. Per-gas fossil fuel: CO2 87997.6695 + CH4 0.0822048x29.8 + N2O 0.0496654x273 = 88013.67785724 kg. The fossil CH4 GWP (29.8) applies because the sheet's biogenic flag is 0, exactly as the PRINCIPAL formula selects it.
Alemania. Same element and factor as the Ball Sesquile row: 26374.29608568 kg.

Bogota. Annual electricity in the Excel's main table: 262525 kWh x 0.21742 = 57078.1855 kg. Our tool captures Scope 2 monthly; the rollup prices any Scope-2 entry by the year's grid factor, and value x factor is linear, so an annual row totals identically.
